Banding: B6 — a right-triangle trig ratio must be RECOGNIZED and inverted, chained with the depression-angle transfer to the triangle’s interior; unfamiliar “solve for the adjacent side” direction.
Modal avoided: angle of elevation with height asked, “h = d tan θ.”
